mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_daily (stat_date, pv, uv) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{pv}, #{uv}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = VALUES(pv), uv = VALUES(uv)
INSERT INTO visit_path_daily (stat_date, path, pv) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{path}, #{pv}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = VALUES(pv)
mapper.select: SELECT stat_date, pv, uv FROM visit_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT path, SUM(pv) AS pv FROM visit_path_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND path NOT LIKE '/admin%' GROUP BY path ORDER BY pv DESC, path ASC LIMIT #{limit}
